script_text: Saturn square your natal Sun hits like a cold shock this week, Aquarius — your Air sign energy meets sudden tension and everything stable is about to shift. Monday through Wednesday, Mercury trine Uranus in your 3rd House sparks bold ideas, making Tuesday your sharpest day. Meanwhile, Monday carries tense Sun square Mars energy that drains you. Midweek, Venus enters Cancer, the 5th House, flooding love and creative energy after weeks of distance. Thursday through Sunday, Jupiter sextile natal Pluto in the 9th House expands career vision. A contract surfaces around Friday. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 5th House and trines your natal Moon. Thursday is your worst day because Saturn opposes Uranus and creates friction in relationships. Use this week to finalize a delayed project rather than chasing new beginnings — Uranus rewards patience in your 2nd House of resources. Follow for daily updates.
